numbered_points: 7 paired do/don't slides (slides 2-8), no numbers, labelled by check and X icons
cta_type: comment_keyword (on 5 of the 7 pair slides), follow, share, save
brand_presence: Logo and 'אחות מוסמכת M.A' top right on slides 2-8 and 12 and the @Lotem_lerner handle at the bottom of slides 2-8 and 11; real photo and full logo on later slides
caption_summary: Very short title only ('עשה ואל תעשה בשינה של תינוקות - חלק 2'), no CTA and no hashtags
what_makes_it_work: The repeating right-versus-wrong split makes each slide a quick yes/no card, and per-slide 'הגיבו הסבר' prompts give several reasons to comment (197 comments) even though the caption has no CTA. Being part 2 of a series reuses an already-proven template.
lumebook_takeaway: A numbered 'part 2' series using one repeatable do/don't card template could let LumeBook publish fast, for example reading-routine do's and don'ts, with a keyword asking for the full reasoning.
